It carries its own independent verification (re-derives every node, checks the partition sums to the whole).

the_false_pass_i_fixed.question: what is the total of the amounts in a.csv and b.csv   (a.csv=10,20  b.csv=30,40)
the_false_pass_i_fixed.why_every_check_passed: every check asks whether the EXPRESSION is sound against the file it chose to read. None asked whether the expression read every subject the SENTENCE named. The single-file answer is bit-identical to a correct one, so a caller could not tell.
the_false_pass_i_fixed.fix: a fourth condition in inspect_v1._answer_stands: subject coverage. It reads named files from the question text and the provenance from the composition's own subject/detail, so the expression cannot satisfy it by agreeing with itself.
the_false_pass_i_fixed.measured_after: 6 genuine answers still verified; the false pass now returns PARTIAL_ANSWER. 7/7 correct behaviour. 36/36 tests pass in that family.

regressions: ZERO. Verified by stashing my inspect_v1 change and re-running the one test that fails: test_the_audit_reports_that_file_and_not_its_siblings fails identically WITHOUT my change (pre-existing).
